port.name: Claude Code
port.description: Living Code for Claude Code: prompt accents, permissions, messages, diffs and subagent colors in four native custom themes.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/claude-code.git
cd claude-code
```

Install in a version of Claude Code whose `/theme` menu includes **New custom theme…**. Copy the JSON files into the personal theme directory:

```sh
mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/themes"
cp themes/*.json "$HOME/.claude/themes/"
```

Restart Claude Code once if that directory did not exist when it started. Run `/theme` and select **Living Code Night**. Later changes hot-reload.
guide.configuration: The files contain a display `name`, a `base` preset and documented `overrides`. Paper inherits `light`; the other flavors inherit `dark`. Diff backgrounds are tinted separately from the brighter word-level highlights. Shimmer colors and all eight subagent colors are included. Your terminal still owns the main screen background; use a matching Living Code terminal theme.
guide.compatibility: Targets the custom-theme JSON API documented in the [Claude Code terminal configuration reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/terminal-config#create-a-custom-theme). This is not a status-line workaround or a patched Claude binary. Old versions with only built-in presets need an update. The `effortUltra` override requires Claude Code 2.1.239 or later; older versions ignore unknown tokens. Fullscreen-only surfaces apply only in fullscreen mode. Tests validate the documented token contract; a full interactive visual capture is not included.
